Please note
No finance charge will be levied (excluding cash advances) in case 100% payment is
made on or before payment due date. Finance charges are levied on all transaction types,
calculated on daily closing balance from transaction date till repayment date. The Foreign
transaction margin for non-AED currency is charged in addition to the standard processing
fee charged by Mastercard or Visa (approximately 1.15%). Bank will give customers notice
before any changes in fees and charges mentioned in this guide, as per applicable laws
and regulations. No refund of annual fees will be made if the Credit Card is cancelled.
Additional expenses, eg: postage, cable, courier, fax, legal fees, etc. will be charged for
where incurred. Charges for services not indicated in this guide are available on request.
For any enquiries on fees, charges, interest rates, etc. please call 600 50 2030. Other terms
and conditions apply. The details on this Service and Price Guide are applicable with effect
from 23rd July 2023 and include all existing charges and revisions made prior to this date.
